visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black cat with short fur is inside a brown wire cage, sniffing at the grey padded floor. The camera is at a slightly low angle. (2) A man wearing a beige long-sleeved shirt and black pants sits on a light wood floor next to a white cat carrier. He handles the carrier and a black cat exits it, moving into the larger wire cage nearby. (3) The cat explores the multi-level wire cage, sniffing different platforms and looking out through the bars towards the room. (4) A hand enters the frame from the right and unlatches the cage door. The cat steps out onto the wood floor. (5) The cat walks around the room, which has light wood flooring and white walls. A person's hand reaches down to pet the cat's head. (6) The cat rubs its body against the person's hand and then playfully bites the person's finger. The person moves their hand away slightly. (7) The cat walks past a small yellow plush toy on the floor and wanders near the base of a white fan. (8) A pink end screen appears with white text logos centered in the frame.
